title: Generalized Guarantees for Variational Inference in the Presence of Even and Elliptical Symmetry
abstract: arXiv:2511.01064v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Variational inference (VI) approximates a target density $p$ by the best match $q$ in a family $\mathcal Q$ of tractable distributions. The variational approximation is found by minimizing a divergence, most commonly the reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence $\text{KL}(q||p)$, although other divergences can be considered. In practice, $p \notin \mathcal Q$ and so the optimal variational approximation is misspecified. Despite this misspecification, it was recently shown that the minimizer of $\text{KL}(q||p)$ is guaranteed to recover the mean in the presence of even symmetry and likewise the correlation matrix in the presence of elliptical symmetry for a log-concave target $p$. We extend this result in several directions. First, we relax the assumption of log-concavity and instead merely require $p$ to be unimodal, allowing for heavy-tailed targets. translated_title: 偶对称与椭圆对称条件下变分推断的广义保证
translated_abstract: 变分推断（VI）通过在一族易于处理的分布 $\mathcal Q$ 中寻找最佳匹配 $q$ 来近似目标密度 $p$。变分近似通过最小化某种散度求得，最常用的是反向 Kullback-Leibler 散度 $\text{KL}(q||p)$，不过也可以考虑其他散度。在实践中，$p \notin \mathcal Q$，因此最优变分近似存在误设（misspecification）。尽管存在这种误设，最近的研究表明，对于对数凹的目标分布 $p$，$\text{KL}(q||p)$ 的最小化点在偶对称条件下保证能够恢复均值，在椭圆对称条件下同样保证能够恢复相关矩阵。我们在若干方向上对这一结果进行了扩展。首先，我们放宽了对数凹性假设，仅要求 $p$ 是单峰的，从而允许目标分布具有重尾特性。其次，我们针对 $p$ 仅在某些（方向上）表现出对称性的情形获得了相应保证……
tldr: 该论文将反向KL散度变分推断在偶对称下恢复均值、椭圆对称下恢复相关矩阵的保证，从对数凹目标分布推广到更一般的单峰（含重尾）目标分布，并扩展至仅部分对称的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes guarantees that reverse-KL variational inference recovers the mean under even symmetry and the correlation matrix under elliptical symmetry, extending them from log-concave targets to unimodal (including heavy-tailed) targets and to settings with only partial symmetry.
